prosody_instruction: Speak softly, as if thinking aloud to oneself rather than addressing anyone. Slow pace, drifting cadence, occasional trailing-off at clause ends. Avoid directive intonation. The tone should feel introspective, distracted, almost wandering — like someone remembering, imagining, or recounting to themselves rather than asking a listener for help.

chunks.text: Last spring I was in Shanghai for a few days, and I remember casually browsing car options there just out of curiosity, even though I ended up using the metro most of the time.
On that trip I also got back into reading—someone kept talking up the novel "To Live", and I jotted it down as the one Sun Lei later checked out.
Funny thing is, my friend David Liu had already booked a Toyota Corolla for me back then—pickup was 2025-04-27 and it was for 4 days, so I didn’t have to think about it.

After I got home, I glanced at my bank app just to make sure everything had settled; the account number on that old screenshot was 6222021234567890, and David Liu’s name was still on the rental email thread.
